text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a shopping trip around the
station, I
happen to catch a glimpse of
someone in a
familiar uniform.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, she ducks into a quiet
alleyway.
I follow after her, and...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey! The hell do ya think you're doin',
followin'
me around?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Depending on your answer, I got some
ideas on
what to do with ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I wasn't following her, and
that I was
just worried because she was
heading somewhere
isolated.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? You're not even my trainer,
so I
guess that makes you a busybody.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, don't worry. I'm just out for a
meal. A
few of my go-to restaurants are
down this alley.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
They're just little holes in the wall, but
the food's
good. Not to mention cheap.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I can't decide if I want tripe stew or curry
today...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Like tripe, do ya? Don't see that
every day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's an acquired taste, so a lotta people
don't like
it. Anyway, why'd ya choose
tripe?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see you're a fellow connoisseur of
healthy
dining.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The modern food they serve in the
cafeteria isn't
horrible, per se...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But sometimes you just wanna enjoy
some good
old-fashioned stewed offal
goodness enhanced
by the natural
sweetness of vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me. There's a racecourse
with a shop
that sells a killer tripe stew.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll head there next time... At any
rate, you
better hurry on home now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Katsu curry? Lookin' for a boost of good
luck or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's a load of superstitious nonsense.
But I
guess it's in our nature to want to
rely on a
greater power.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it wouldn't hurt to play along
today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I feel like eating alone today.
choice_data_list: They have katsu curry at the academy too, though.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I eat at school, overly friendly folks
like
yourself will just keep droppin' by to
stick their
nose in my business.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whereas here in the alley, I don't need
to say a
word beyond what I want to eat.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Though, I guess the way they give me
extra-large
portions without asking
sometimes is just their
quiet way of
meddling.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me. There's a racecourse
with a
curry restaurant famous for its
extra-large
portions.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll head there next time... At any
rate, you
better hurry on home now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Nakayama Festa turns
on her
heel and disappears into the
alley.
